verdict_reason: New address-book HTTP client correctly encodes path IDs, scopes via org header/trace, maps 400 problem errors for forms, and is covered by nock tests; only a Minor statusText omission on thrown errors.

todos.issue: throwOnError (and the create/update 400 branches) attach error.status and error.body but omit error.statusText required by the fetch-client error shape
todos.fix: Set error.statusText = response.statusText wherever a non-OK response is turned into a thrown Error; ideally fold the 400 branches into throwOnError so there is one construction path
